turns.text: Hello. The limited print arrived creased. I want a reprint, not my money back.
I’m sorry the print arrived creased. Please send the order number (SC-####) and the email address used for the order so I can verify it and file your damage claim. I’ve noted that you want a reprint.
Order SC-5221, email valeska.taranu@example.com. Delivery was within the last two weeks.
I’ve filed your damage claim requesting a reprint. It’s pending staff approval; staff will ask you for a photo and decide on the claim.

rule.ro: Un print deteriorat sau tipărit greșit se semnalează în 14 zile de la livrare. Clientul primește o retipărire sau banii înapoi. Echipa cere o fotografie și aprobă soluția.
rule.en: Report a damaged or misprinted print within 14 days of delivery. The customer gets a reprint or a refund. Staff ask for a photo and approve.

turns.text: Please file the damage claim with a reprint. I can send a photo to the team.
The damage claim requesting a reprint has already been filed and is pending staff approval. The team will ask you for a photo.
One side question: are limited drops ever restocked? Answer that, then I will come back to the claim.
Limited-drop prints are never restocked and can’t be reserved.

rule.ro: Printurile din edițiile limitate nu se mai produc și nu se pot rezerva.
rule.en: Limited-drop prints are never restocked and cannot be reserved.

turns.text: I have changed my mind. I want a full refund for the damaged print. If the claim is already on file for a reprint, please change its remedy to a refund.
I couldn’t change the claim to a refund because a person must decide on refunds over 1,000 lei. I’ve passed your request and the pending damage claim to a colleague, who will take over.

error.message: A person decides any refund above 1000 lei. Hand the conversation over with reason staff_decision.

input.summary: Verified order SC-5221 contains a limited print priced at 1320 RON. A damage claim for a reprint was filed as R-1 and is pending staff approval. Customer now requests changing the remedy to a full refund; amendment was refused by policy because refunds above 1000 lei require a person to decide. Please review the requested refund and damage claim.
